  • Architect and maintain high-throughput payment orchestration services handling fiat deposits, crypto swaps, stable token mint/burn, and instant settlements.
  • Build reconciliation systems that sync on-chain events (EVM, Solana, Stellar) with off-chain ledgers and banking rails (ACH, SEPA, SWIFT, SPEI).
  • Implement risk, fraud, and AML controls in real-time transaction pipelines.
  • Design idempotent, event-driven microservices using Kafka / Pulsar and domain-driven patterns.
  • Own blockchain node infrastructure (Geth, Solana RPC, custom indexers) and write secure smart-contract interaction layers.
  • Scale systems to 10k+ TPS with sub-100ms latency for cross-border flows.
  • Collaborate with compliance and product teams to embed KYC/KYT, travel-rule data, and sanction screening.

Must-Have Skills
  • 5+ years backend engineering in high-scale environments.

    • EVM-compatible chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum)

    • MEV, gas optimization, and on-chain data indexing (The Graph, Dune, custom subsql)
  • Mastery of Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node.js (we primarily use Go).
  • Event sourcing, CQRS, and distributed transaction patterns.
  • Secure handling of HSMs, key management (KMS, MPC), and cryptographic signing.
  • Observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK.
  • Experience with regulated environments (PCI-DSS, SOC2, PSD2, FinCEN travel rule).
Nice-to-Have
  • Built or audited stablecoin issuance/redemption systems.
  • Contributed to open-source blockchain tooling or payment protocols.
  • Worked with layer-2 networks (Optimism, Base, zkSync) or cross-chain bridges.
  • Familiarity with ISO 20022, FedNow, or RTP rails.
Tech Stack
  • Core: Go, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka
  • Blockchain: Solidity, Hardhat, Foundry, ethers.js, viem, Solana SDK
  • Infra: Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP/AWS, Grafana Tempo
  • Security: HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Fireblocks MPC
Why Join 3thix

  • Unlimited PTO + global off-sites.

  • Work directly with ex-Stripe, Circle, and Coinbase engineers.

description:
Especialista em Ciência de Dados (Meteorologia)

Join to apply for the Especialista em Ciência de Dados (Meteorologia) role at AXIA Energia

Sobre a AXIA Energia

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN). Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro. Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta. Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições Descrição do Cargo

Liderar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de modelos de análise de dados avançados e inteligência artificial no Centro de Monitoramento ATMOS. O objetivo é aprimorar o monitoramento e previsão meteorológica, como instrumento nos processos de operação e de manutenção dos ativos de geração e transmissão da AXIA Energia, utilizando insights baseados em dados para minimizar o impacto de intempéries para empresa.

Principais Atividades
  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados meteorológicos e climáticos de diversas fontes - oriundos de modelos de previsão numérica e dados operacionais (tempo real e históricos);
  • Desenvolver algoritmos preditivos baseados em treinamento de dados para reconhecer padrões e relacionamentos para eventos meteorológicos críticos;
  • Criar algoritmos e scripts para automatizar processos de análise e previsão meteorológica e climática;
  • Construir dashboards interativos e relatórios analíticos;
  • Colaborar com meteorologistas, engenheiros e analistas para interpretar os dados à luz da meteorologia aplicada à operação, gestão e manutenção de ativos de transmissão e de geração, além de outras áreas de negócio da AXIA Energia.
Requisitos e qualificações Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Formação Superior completo em Ciência de Dados, Meteorologia, Engenharia, Estatística, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio em técnicas de Machine Learning, Modelagem Estatística e Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à meteorologia, climatologia e engenharia ambiental;
  • Proficiência em linguagens como Python ou R, com experiência em bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow ou PyTorch;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, processamento de dados em tempo real e ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Excelência na criação de dashboards interativos (Power BI) e visualizações voltadas à tomada de decisão;
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de dados, pipelines de ETL e ambientes em nuvem (cloud).
Requisitos Desejáveis
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Machine Learning, Data Analytics ou Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência com dados meteorológicos operacionais, modelagem preditiva e integração de sistemas é um diferencial relevante.

  • Previdência Privada;
  • Vale-Transporte;

title: Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore
description:
Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore

PRIO Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore role at PRIO

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Buscamos Supervisor de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore para uma das nossas unidades:

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Reportar imediatamente ao Gerente da unidade qualquer risco real ou potencial observado durante a execução de qualquer atividade, paralisando o serviço caso o risco seja iminente.
  • Treinar, orientar e compor o time de resposta a emergência da unidade nas ações específicas de resposta, organizando e participando dos exercícios e simulados de emergência.
  • Realizar palestras e treinamentos de segurança e meio ambiente conforme demanda.
  • Coordenar e apoiar o Gerente da unidade e demais departamentos nas ações referentes às políticas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.
  • Disseminar a cultura de segurança, através de ações para promover a segurança entre nossos colaboradores, com o objetivo de difundir os princípios de segurança e fundamentos de segurança de processo.
  • Coordenar as auditorias de Permissões de trabalho e inspeções nos equipamentos e sistemas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar o atendimento à Matriz de Treinamento da equipe de bordo.
  • Assegurar que a equipe de técnicos de segurança seja treinada e capacitada na aplicação das ferramentas de gestão tais como Greendocs, procedimentos, sistema de PT digital, cartão de observação, registros de incidentes, inspeções rotineiras, listas de verificações, análises de riscos, permissões de trabalho, entre outros, por meio de treinamentos internos definidos nos procedimentos estabelecidos pela organização.
  • Contribuir e ser o facilitador nas investigações de acidentes/incidentes junto à operação, propondo ações de melhorias por meio de técnicas de análises eficazes que garantam a redução e/ou eliminação dos eventos indesejáveis.
Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico)

  • Formação técnica de Segurança do Trabalho.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória

  • Sólida experiência como Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho Offshore e com liderança de times.
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, queremos saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Job Description

The Sr. Director/Director, Data Intelligence (ADDI) will support pre-award study feasibility strategy through targeted data gathering and analysis.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Supports overall operational strategy globally, with a focus on our key therapeutic areas of Oncology and Rare Disease, so as to maximize Ergomed’s revenue and reputation by ensuring that relevant data from available data sources are researched, aggregated, and available to the Directors of Operational Strategy (DOSs) in the timelines required to prepare and deliver high quality, well-research proposals to Ergomed’s potential clients.
  • Assists with RFP, RFI, proposal review and response as directed by developing strategically targeted feasibility and related data packages including relevant graphics that support the Win Strategy for new business opportunities.
  • Analyzes trial protocols, study designs, and other project details to determine feasibility within the organization's capabilities and knowledge base and leverages those analyses when presenting feasibility data package.
  • Evaluates potential risks, challenges, and constraints associated with proposed projects, with a focus on any potential impact on feasibility activities and recruitment rate projections.
  • Researches and analyzes the current market trends, competitive landscape, and therapeutic area dynamics relevant to each proposed project.
  • Develops and maintains feasibility summaries including relevant graphics for specific indications as requested by the direct supervisor or the SVP, SSPC to minimize rework (e.g., landscape summaries for certain oncology indications as determined by the Director of Operational Strategy Oncology, the Senior Director of Operational and Clinical Intelligence and/or the SVP, SPCC).
  • Documents which feasibility activities and search criteria have been used when transferring preaward feasibility data packages internally in case of absence to minimize rework or at project handover to post-award feasibility team.
  • Supports the development of processes and solutions to maximize pre-award feasibility package development and integration into the larger win strategy.

description:

  • Experiência prática com segurança em ambientes de nuvem (AWS é um grande diferencial);
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de segurança, como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e OWASP Top 10;
  • Capacidade de automatizar tarefas de segurança com linguagens de script (Python, Shell etc.);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de EDR/XDR (Endpoint Detection and Response), como SentinelOne ou equivalentes – desejável;
  • Certificações de segurança ofensiva (ex.: OSCP, OSCE) e/ou defensiva (ex.: GCIH, GCFA, CISSP) – desejável;

  • Experiência com análise de malware e forense digital – desejável;

description:
Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities
  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer‑centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement
Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
Benefits
  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!
Why 1GLOBAL?
  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
We’re helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, 24 hours/week (with potential to transition to full time)
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $1440-$2200 (based on a 24‑hour workweek, depending on level of experience); $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3‑statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation‑ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model‑Led)
    Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double‑check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies ; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn‑outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self‑check work before submission.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • Theyown the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • Theybalance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • Theytranslate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Finance Case + bonus assignment

  3. Second Interview

  4. Valuation Case Test

  5. Final Interview

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

Position Summary

The Vice President of Clinical Operations and Finance is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic oversight and operational excellence of clinical and financial functions across the Faculty Practice Plan. This role ensures the delivery of high-quality, cost-effective care while maintaining financial sustainability and regulatory compliance. The Vice President will lead cross‑functional teams, optimize workflows, and collaborate with executive leadership to drive innovation, performance, and growth. The Vice President will implement the FPP’s Strategic 2030 Market Expansion plan. The Vice President reports to the Chief Executive Officer of the FPP.

Strategic Leadership
  • Develop and execute integrated strategies that align clinical operations with financial goals and institutional priorities.
  • Lead initiatives to scale clinical services, improve patient access, and enhance operational efficiency.
Clinical Operations Oversight
  • Direct multi‑disciplinary teams to ensure effective execution of clinical workflows, service delivery, and compliance.
  • Implement and monitor KPIs such as patient wait times, double‑booking volume, appointment utilization rates, and provider panel sizes to drive operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with department chairs to improve workflows and improve access to care across high‑volume specialties.
Financial Management
  • Direct the preparation and distribution of monthly financial reports, including service line profitability, provider productivity, and departmental budget performance.
  • Monitor provider productivity (e.g., wRVUs, cFTEs) and ensure alignment with MGMA benchmarks.
  • Lead the annual operating budget process, including baseline development, variance analysis, and iterative forecasting in collaboration with finance partners.
Performance Optimization
  • Conduct quarterly performance reviews for clinical departments and individual providers, analyzing wRVU trends, encounter volume, charges, and payments.
  • Lead performance reviews and develop action plans to enhance clinical and financial outcomes.
  • Lead Lean Six Sigma or DMAIC projects to reduce operational waste, improve patient flow, and enhance financial performance.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Facilitate regular strategy sessions with senior leadership, department chairs, and finance teams to align clinical and financial priorities.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support strategic initiatives and operational goals.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for external consultants, payers, and vendors involved in clinical operations and financial planning.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Realizar processos de Recrutamento e Seleção para profissionais de todas as categorias, obedecendo aos métodos adotados pela Instituição.

Buscamos um(a) Museólogo(a) , para atuar em conservação e pesquisa do acervo museológico do Clube de Regatas do Flamengo.   • Documentação museológica: Desenvolver atividades de inventário, catalogação e laudo técnico conforme as normas do ICOM e Diretrizes do Sistema Brasileiro de Museus; controlar os processos de aquisição, empréstimo e circulação de acervo.

  • Acervos em itinerância: Acompanhar deslocamento de acervo museológico, em transporte, e montagem e desmontagem de exposições fora da instituição. Com disponibilidade para viagens, caso necessário.
Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Museologia;

title: Supervisor de Área
description:
Supervisor de Área – Grupo Lothar Descreva a Vaga

É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Realiza vistorias nos equipamentos utilizados pelos vigilantes, como rádios comunicadores, lanternas, sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, garantindo que todos estejam funcionando corretamente e que os profissionais estejam com os EPIs e materiais exigidos para a função.

Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

Requisitos da Vaga
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório).
  • Curso de Formação de Vigilante (obrigatório).
  • Curso de Supervisão de Segurança (desejável).
  • Ensino Superior em Gestão de Segurança Privada, Administração ou áreas correlatas (desejável).
  • Certificado de Curso de Vigilante atualizado, conforme Portaria da Polícia Federal.
  • Habilitação: CNH Categoria A/B (obrigatória – o supervisor pode atuar com moto ou carro).
  • Experiência comprovada como vigilante.
  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência como líder de equipe, inspetor ou supervisor de segurança.
  • Vivência com rondas operacionais e atendimento ao cliente será considerado um diferencial.

description:
Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle) ID40979

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award‑winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas such as application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager with 3+ years of experience to connect prospective clients and internal teams. You will lead discovery sessions, capture key details like timelines and budgets, and turn insights into clear, high‑impact proposals. Strong knowledge of business strategy, the SDLC, and excellent communication skills are essential.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  • Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement:
    • Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information following internal RACI procedures.
    • Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly.
    • Demonstrate in‑depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility.
    • Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high‑level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments.
    • Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client‑facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.
  • Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation:
    • Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations.
    • Customize deliverables to reflect client‑specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings.
    • Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long‑term client growth.
  • Team Buildout and Project Kickoff:
    • Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand‑offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick‑off.
    • Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding.
    • Serve as a trusted advisor during pre‑sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business‑focused narratives.
    • Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.
MUST HAVES
  • 3+ years of experience in similar Sales & Delivery Management roles.
  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client‑facing interactions.
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high‑quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre‑sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

  • Experience working in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos oCLUDE SAÚDE – Programa de serviços como Telemedicina e Telepsicologia oferecendo suporte e recursos para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;

No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com oDAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.

E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nossoPROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.

This position is based in Arlington-VA (hybrid), Bogota-Colombia (hybrid) or Brazil (fully remote). This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes.     • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management
  • Ensure financial systems are up to date and used to maximum effect:
  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.

  • Documentation and Training

You’ll define and execute the growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization—using experimentation, analytics, and customer insights to turn product usage into sustained revenue growth. Being a Model Auditor at Nubank is different from being a traditional auditor. Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure
The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  • 1. Act with an open mindset:
    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model. Build quality relationships with the management team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.
  • 2. Create positive impact working with others:
    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect. Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input. Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes. Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.
  • 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:
    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards. Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations. Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty. Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.
  • 4. Consistently deliver excellence:
    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets. Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel. Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market. Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan. Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.
  • 5. Enable team success:
    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning. Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities. Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement. Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures. As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.
  • 6. Create clarity:
    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy. Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members. Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process. Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.
  • 7. Inspire for top performance:
    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best. Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements. Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks. Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition. Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents. Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated. Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.
Additional Information
  • Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)
  • Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.
  • Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)
  • Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)
  • Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture
  • Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.
  • Experience in managing owner relations.
  • Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit
  • Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.
  • Creative and innovative mindset.
  • Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.
  • Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.
  • Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.

o que começou como um pequeno estande numa feira de moda tornou-se uma loja e depois uma rede de lojas que conquistou cidades, estados e até outros países. hoje, somos mais de 100 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil inteiro, sem contar as localizadas fora do país, com mais de 2000 colaboradores para fazer tudo acontecer.

vem fazer parte do nosso time!

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

estamos à procura de gente que ama conhecer gente, que escuta de verdade, sente vontade de entender o outro, ama desafios e gosta da jornada até lá, mesmo que tenha alguns obstáculos no caminho.

quer fazer parte desta jornada de vendas e atendimento com a gente?

  • Realizar o atendimento ao cliente com gentileza;
  • Garantir eficiência:
  • Prestando atendimento online através dos canais digitais;
  • Realizando abertura e fechamento do caixa;
  • Recebendo, conferindo e enviando mercadorias;
  • Finalizando as vendas;
  • Apoiando a gerente no acompanhamento dos indicadores de venda
  • Sendo o responsável administrativo da loja, nas seguintes atividades: gestão de solicitação de insumos, gerenciamento das contas a pagar, garantia de que processos e equipamentos da loja estejam em pleno funcionamento
  • Oferecendo suporte à gerência em atividades diversas.
  • Colaborar com a gerência para garantir a experiência física da loja, mantendo-a atraente e organizada e encantando sempre os clientes;

·Se sentir bem como você é;

·Respeitar a todos como são;

·Ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil de se adaptar e organizada;

·Ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;

·Entender que o dia a dia é desafiador não só porque contempla muitas atividades, mas porque você está ali ajudando a realizar sonho e melhorar a autoestima das clientes

·Ter habilidade de facilidade de comunicação (oratória e “escutatória”) facilita demais o bom relacionamento interpessoal

·Conhecimento básico do pacote Office e habilidade com ferramentas tecnológicas

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

  • Noções de gestão de pessoas e processos de recrutamento e seleção.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Registrar junto ao Conselho de classe (COREN) a responsabilidade técnica da unidade;
  • Compor Comissões como as de prontuário e PGRSS;
  • Supervisionar e garantir o cumprimento das atividades de sua área e participar das atividades integradas com as demais áreas;
  • Avaliar e acompanhar a produtividade de enfermagem de acordo com os parâmetros estabelecidos;
  • Realizar o dimensionamento do quadro de pessoal da equipe de enfermagem para a qualidade na assistência prestada;
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe de enfermagem para discussão técnicas e administrativas e também ações corretivas e educativas, motivadas pelas não conformidades identificadas nos registros de assistência;
  • Assegurar que a assistência de Enfermagem seja prestada seguindo os preceitos de segurança, de forma humanizada e individualizada;
  • Avaliar periodicamente o nível de qualificação técnica dos empregados de sua responsabilidade e manter o controle sobre a assiduidade e disciplina dos mesmos;
  • Participar da elaboração das rotinas dos serviços de enfermagem em conjunto com o Gestor bem como mantê-las atualizada;
  • Supervisionar o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas pelo Controle de Infecção Hospitalar nos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Experiência mínima de 02 (dois) anos comprovada em Gestão de equipe de Enfermagem.
  • Especialização Completa em Gestão Hospitalar, Gestão de Saúde, ou áreas afins.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;

  • Capacidade comprovada de comunicação, negociação e gestão de pessoas

Somos uma empresa que, em um curto espaço de tempo, construiu uma sólida reputação no setor da engenharia e construção. Estamos conectadoscom as principais inovações, formados por um time com vasta experiência e reconhecimento no mercado.

Você se considera um profissional fora da curva?

Se a resposta for sim, essa vaga é para você.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Segurança Operacional para reforçar nosso compromisso com a segurança das equipes e operações, tanto em campo quanto no ambiente corporativo.

Sobre a empresa

O Grupo DR1 é uma empresa especializada em prestação de serviços através de soluções integradas utilizando drones. Somos uma empresa líder de mercado de inspeção com drones e conseguimos isso graças a uma equipe focada em eficiência e resultados, movidos pelo seu espírito desafiador, jovem e dinâmico.

Para saber mais acesse: .

Principais Atividades
  • Conduzir debriefings de operações, consolidando métricas e lições aprendidas;
  • Emitir e acompanhar feedbacks de logística relacionados às operações;
  • Gerir ações pós-incidente/acidente/desvio, garantindo implementação de medidas corretivas;
  • Controlar e manter atualizadas as documentações de QSMS;
  • Acompanhar não conformidades e coordenar planos de fechamento;
  • Organizar e conduzir reuniões quinzenais de segurança, registrando temas e ações definidas;
  • Apoiar a gestão de risco, incluindo atualização da matriz de risco e comprovação de ciência por parte de todos os colaboradores;
  • Realizar análises aleatórias de logs de voo;
  • Verificar semanalmente os Stop Cards, controlando as ações dos mais relevantes;
  • Participar de reuniões iniciais de serviços (kick-off), reforçando diretrizes de segurança;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar operações em campo, com foco em segurança operacional;
  • Elaborar e ministrar treinamentos periódicos de segurança operacional (onshore e offshore);
  • Conduzir inspeções de campo e auditorias internas em áreas de risco, emitindo relatórios e recomendações;
  • Atuar como facilitador de programas de cultura de segurança, incentivando reporte de desvios e boas práticas;
  • Monitorar e reportar indicadores de performance em segurança (KPIs de QSMS), com análise crítica e propostas de melhoria;
  • Apoiar no planejamento e execução de simulados de emergência (incêndio, abandono, primeiros socorros);
  • Garantir conformidade com legislações, NRs e normas internacionais (ANAC, DECEA, RBAC 94, ABS/DNV, ISO 45001, ISO 14001);
  • Controlar e manter atualizados os EPIs e EPCs, garantindo rastreabilidade de inspeções e validade de certificados;
  • Participar de investigações de incidentes/acidentes, aplicando metodologias reconhecidas (árvore de causas, 5 porquês, ICAM);
  • Auxiliar na gestão de jornada e fadiga de operadores em deslocamentos terrestres ou offshore;
  • Apoiar a área de operações na gestão de mudanças (MOC – Management of Change), garantindo que alterações operacionais tenham análise de risco prévia.
Qualificações
  • Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho (registro ativo obrigatório);
  • Conhecimento em QSMS, gestão de riscos, incidentes e auditorias internas;
  • Experiência em operações de alto risco (óleo e gás, mineração, energia ou setores similares);
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão integrados (QSMS/HSE Management Systems);
  • Capacidade de elaborar relatórios técnicos, métricas e controles de segurança;
  • Habilidade para conduzir toolbox talks e briefings de segurança em campo;
  • CNH categoria B válida e disponibilidade para viagens onshore e offshore;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado será considerado diferencial;
  • Diferenciais opcionais: cursos CBSP e T-HUET para operações offshore.
