Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsável por fornecer soluções inovadoras para os problemas dos clientes, ou seja, capturar os requisitos de negócios e transformá-los por meio de análise e design em soluções técnicas.

Principais atividades
  • Atuar na análise de requisitos de negócio e na definição de soluções técnicas, com foco em inovação e aderência às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Projetar e definir arquiteturas de sistemas complexos, novos ou legados, considerando escalabilidade, segurança, desempenho e interoperabilidade;
  • Conduzir o levantamento técnico de requisitos junto a stakeholders, traduzindo demandas funcionais e não funcionais em especificações arquiteturais;
  • Elaborar propostas técnicas detalhadas, incluindo modelos de arquitetura, fluxos de integração e definição de componentes;
  • Realizar avaliação de sistemas existentes, identificando oportunidades de refatoração, modernização e integração;
  • Desenvolver planos de testes, estratégias de validação e cronogramas de implementação para as soluções propostas;
  • Diagnosticar e propor soluções para problemas técnicos relacionados à comunicação entre sistemas, serviços e plataformas;
  • Gerenciar projetos técnicos: controle de demandas, avaliação de viabilidade, acompanhamento de entregas e produção de documentação técnica;
  • Aplicar técnicas de inteligência artificial e aprendizado de máquina para apoiar a automação de processos, análise preditiva, classificação de dados e melhoria contínua das soluções desenvolvidas.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft 365: Administração de ambientes e serviços, com foco em gestão de identidades, grupos, políticas de segurança e conformidade;
  • Power Platform: Administração de ambientes, incluindo Dataverse;
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações em Power Apps (model-driven, canvas e portal);
  • Automação de processos e integração de sistemas utilizando Power Automate;
  • SharePoint Online: Gestão de Site Collections, desenvolvimento de sites modernos, estruturação de conteúdo e aplicação de políticas de governança;
  • Azure: Administração de Resource Groups, monitoramento de serviços, análise de desempenho e resolução de falhas com base em logs e métricas;
  • SQL Server (Azure e On-premises): Execução de queries, administração de bancos de dados, gerenciamento de gateways e publicação de dashboards no Power BI;
  • Power BI: Criação de dashboards interativos, administração de workspaces e integração com fontes de dados diversas;
  • Copilot Studio: Desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial, incluindo a criação de agentes personalizados para automação de atendimento e integração com sistemas corporativos;
  • Power Virtual Agents (PVA): Criação, treinamento e gestão de chatbots inteligentes, com foco em experiência do usuário e eficiência operacional;
  • Microsoft Fabric: Administração de Data Lakes, organização de dados e suporte a iniciativas de análise avançada;
  • Gestão de mudanças e incidentes: Atuação em processos de ITSM, com foco em governança, rastreabilidade e mitigação de riscos;
  • Inteligência Artificial: Experiência na aplicação de técnicas de IA e machine learning em soluções corporativas, incluindo automação inteligente, análise preditiva, classificação de dados e integração com serviços cognitivos da Microsoft;
  • Obrigatória formação Superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Inteligência Artificial, Microsoft Power Plat ou áreas afins serão considerados diferenciais.

description:
About 1GLOBAL

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licences, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL delivers seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. The company serves leading banks, corporations and digital‑first businesses, connects over 43 million devices worldwide and operates as a fully regulated MVNO in ten countries and a regulated telecom operator in 31 more. Established in 2022, it employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

As a Network Engineering member in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analyzing, and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. You will prepare, design, test, and provide new solutions or product changes to the existing portfolio and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participation and support of other functional areas on cross‑functional projects are also part of the role.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successful candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon.

Fluency in English is essential.

Key Responsibilities
  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing projects for delivery of new solutions.
  • Project delivery, network design, integration, and migration strategy definition. Responsible for end‑to‑end delivery.
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions.
  • Creation and maintenance of technical documentation (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.) throughout the lifecycle.
  • Implementation in live environment; understanding of end‑to‑end system testing requirements.
  • Follow‑up and definition of quality and performance indicators.
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting, and improvement solution definition.
  • Service and resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems.
  • Work on complex solutions that influence current product design and address future product or technology issues.
  • Maintain close relationships with external partners such as carriers and service providers.
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network necessities.
  • Control the network elements roadmap, ensuring necessary software/hardware upgrades during the component lifecycle.
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross‑team processes.
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements or alternatives.
Requirements Must Have
  • Proven experience implementing live solutions on mobile telecom networks (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS).
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications.
  • Experience designing, testing, and operating NGN‑based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC.
  • Experience defining, establishing, and maintaining SIP/RTP‑based voice interconnects.
  • Understanding of IMS architecture, VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, QoS.
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing.
  • Knowledge of IMS nodes (P/S/I‑CSCF, Application Servers).
  • Knowledge of IMS protocol interfaces (Gm, ISC, Sh, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc.).
  • Experience in mobile services charging, including offline/online OCS, Ro, Ro+, Ga, Bp interfaces.
  • Knowledge of Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols.
  • Knowledge of signalling gateways and protocols, including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP, CAMEL.
  • Experience using protocol analyser tools such as Wireshark, Astelia.
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions.
  • Familiarity with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s).
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages a plus.
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
Nice to Have
  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks.
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, and Ribbon IMS products.
Benefits
  • CLT contract – job stability and reliable benefits.
  • Quarterly performance bonuses.
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card – R$100 per working day.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica – 50% covered by the company.
  • Extended parental leave – 180 days maternity, 20 days paternity.
  • Daycare allowance for mothers with children under 3 years – R$500 per month per child.
  • Onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin).

1GLOBAL is an equal‑opportunity employer. Diversity drives our innovation and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

The focus of this role will be on all presales activities around the Dynamics 365 platform as well as methodology diagnostics and high‑level solution architecting. You will also contribute to proposal development and provide input in business development while mentor junior and offshore staff.

This role is therefore kingpin to our client’s customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions. It is a dynamic and exciting opportunity to join a rapidly developing business area within an established and market‑leading global firm that is our client.

  • Should have architected, designed and implemented at least 7‑8 full scale industry solutions using Dynamics CE (CRM), Integrations, Power Platform; Strong understanding of industry domains like Banking, Finance, Healthcare, Insurance, Telecom, Manufacturing etc.
  • Ability to architect solutions that involve multi-region implementations
  • Strong technical leadership for engagements and ability to present to the C‑Suite stakeholders
  • Ability to architect and design Digital Transformation programs involving multiple technologies

Skills and Qualifications

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbally and in writing
  • In‑depth knowledge of all modules of Dynamics 365 CE, including appropriate Architect level certifications. Relevant experience on various earlier versions of Dynamics CRM like, 2016, 2015, 2013, 2011, CRM 4.0 etc.
  • Strong implementation experience with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Apps Portals aka Power Pages, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Power BI, RPA etc.), including appropriate Architect level certification
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, Development management, Release management, Data migration, cut‑over planning and Go‑Live support
  • Experience with Azure Platform and Integration Services including LogicApps, Functions, Azure Service Bus etc.
  • Experience working with offshore development teams
  • Experience of Agile Methodology
  • Certification in TOGAF or Zachman Framework would be beneficial
  • Knowledge of other Marketing products are desirable – Click Dimension or Adobe Marketing Cloud, D365 for Marketing etc.
  • Graduate from a recognized University with majors in computational (Computer Science, Information Technology etc.) discipline

Responsibilities

  • The Solution Architect will lead the delivery of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions
  • Be a champion/SME (Subject Matter Expert) for both technical and functional solutions across the Microsoft platform, driving the adoption of new features and technology
  • Possess strong understanding of Dynamics 365 & power platform stack and stay relevant with new features

title: Staff Platform Engineer, Americas
description:
We’re looking for a curious, rigorous, problem-hungry platform engineer (who codes!) to carry the ball as we bring Ashby to the big leagues. Ashby builds software that lets talent teams build an efficient, delightful, respectful hiring process. Similarly, you’re an engineer who wants to build a “paved road” that excellent engineering teams can safely take to the moon and back.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 2500 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we’re hiring for this role.

We’ve listed this role twice: as a Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer – our team does both, and we are open to candidates who lean towards one or the other.

About the role and how we work

Hi I’m Colin, Head of EMEA Engineering. I’ve spent a number of years leading engineering teams in startups, and that has always included being close to infrastructure teams - no matter what name they’ve worn (SRE, infrastructure, platform, etc). I’ve got my hands dirty building the initial infrastructure for startups and know the value a talented infrastructure engineer brings. The rigour, the discipline, the peace and quiet when everything just hums along.

Our infrastructure is in a good place for now. Nothing is static. Ashby continues to grow rapidly, putting strain on our existing infrastructure. We’re always looking to give our customers more powerful hiring software, and building new product features often requires new pieces of infrastructure.

Having herded plenty of snowflake servers in the past, I’ve learned there’s a better way. I (and Ashby) place a lot of value on code-as-infrastructure. As a Platform Engineer at Ashby, you’ll get to dive into scaling problems, add new capabilities to our platform, and think about how our entire team interacts with infrastructure. All our own engineers own their projects end-to-end and ship with minimal oversight. We don’t put roadblocks to ensure security when common sense will do and we don’t build processes like change management boards around the lowest common denominator. But with great power comes great responsibility: we handle personal and confidential data about some of the biggest decisions we ever make at work. As we grow, more and bigger customers rely on us to be reliable and secure and how we operate internally will need to evolve.

We’re at an inflection point where our ability to scale and deliver a seamless experience has a make-or-break impact – we have some of the fastest growing companies using our platform every day to hire hundreds of people per month. We need someone like you to make good decisions, debug thorny issues, and build us a future-proof platform that can withstand this scale. Our small but mighty infrastructure team has set up a secure and simple environment (we don’t believe in spinning up a new service unless necessary!) for our growing product team to build in. That’s where you come in: you, too, will own projects end-to-end and have an impact on core parts of the Ashby developer and user experience. For instance, you could work on:

  • Optimize our homegrown ultra-dynamic recruiting DSL-to-SQL compiler, and create tools to help developers do so
  • Create automated guardrails for the security and privacy of our customer data
  • Help our developers ship features fast through canary deploys, gradual rollouts and feature flags, while keeping complexity manageable and reducing downtime
  • Work with the business and the engineering team to define SLOs and implement the corresponding SLIs.
  • Ensure all communication with external services supports circuit-breakers.
  • Implement the infrastructure to support an event-driven architecture and data warehouse.
Why you should or shouldn’t apply

You should apply if:

  • You never stop. You get weirdly obsessed about a problem that doesn’t yet make sense, turn it every which way in your head until the explanation dawns. You’ll search every rock, inventory every clue, hunt every mismatch. We do that, too – together we’ll be armed with state‑of‑the‑art monitoring tools and an impressive amount of data, and join you in the adventure.
  • You don’t take shortcuts. You’re speaking up for the future user, the edge case, the doomsday design. You know product engineers want to build it with you, and see them as allies, where you give them the power and knowledge to access greater things.
  • You’re someone who cares about what you do and the team you do it with, and want to work with others who do as well. You’ll be on interview panels choosing your next colleagues, and you’ll take that seriously. You only want to work with people who make you better, and want to make you better.
  • You’ve built infrastructure at a slightly later stage than Ashby is at - you know how to deal with millions of data points, have seen great (or not great) infrastructure make or break customer experience, and have automated everything from provisioning to monitoring and release process.
  • You’re a Swiss army knife (all nationalities welcome). You’ll get every hard problem the company faces. You’ll get to do infrastructure updates, security enforcements, database optimization, Kubernetes debugging, and digging through Typescript traces figuring out what doesn’t work. You probably don’t feel like an expert at at least some of that… and that appeals to you.

You should not apply if:

  • You don’t want to make your own decisions on what is the best paved road to build for Ashby, and expect a lead or manager to make the final call on what that is. Our leads (and managers) give ample commentary and feedback on technical decisions and how they’re made, but you ship what you want to build and are accountable for it.
  • You hate SQL. We have a lot of features built around making the best out of data, and our platform engineers also sometimes dive into a gnarly report or advise engineers on a more performant data model to use.
  • You don’t want to code. Our SREs are some of our best software engineers and they are just as responsible for the application as the other engineering teams – albeit at a platform level. Reviewing code and submitting code changes will be part of your day to day.
  • Your primary mode of communicating best practices to engineers is live meetings. We’re a very async culture and written communication (and code) is how changes get made. As an Ashby SRE, you will need to share new tooling and best practices with engineers faster than your next meeting opportunity will take you.
  • You’ve never delivered a project, on your own, without someone prodding you for updates. We have no project or delivery managers to fill your calendar with busy work, but the flip side is you have to do your project management, seek the help you need to get unstuck and cut scope when it’s worthwhile.
Technology Stack

We use TypeScript (frontend & backend), Node.js, React, Apollo GraphQL, Postgres, Redis. We use Datadog and Sentry on 100% cloud‑based (AWS) infra. We take developer experience and reliability seriously: all engineers are on call in a follow‑the‑sun model, and everyone contributes to developer tooling.

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top‑tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high‑quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Cloud & Industrial Edge Architect
description:
Snapshot of Your Day

You’ll help design and operate the hybrid (on-prem + cloud) infrastructure that powers Siemens Energy’s industrial digitalization solutions. With solid experience in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge of GCP and AWS, you’ll contribute to building secure, reliable, and scalable connections between industrial (OT) environments and cloud platforms, enabling data services, analytics, and smarter operations.

How You’ll Make An Impact
  • Support the design and implementation of hybrid architectures connecting edge/on-prem systems with the cloud.
  • Deploy and maintain cloud and edge components for data ingestion, storage, and monitoring.
  • Enable secure OT–IT integrations (VPN, private links, authentication, certificates).
  • Develop Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD automation practice.
  • Monitor and tune performance, cost, and reliability of deployed environments.
  • Work closely with automation, data, and product teams to bring industrial data into digital platforms.
  • Participate in solution reviews, proposals, and technical discussions with internal and external partners.
What You Bring
  • 5+ years crafting, building, and operating cloud/hybrid infrastructure for production systems.
  • 3+ years hands‑on with Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, networking, security, IAM, monitoring).
  • Exposure to GCP or AWS (some practical experience is welcome, not mandatory).
  • Strong hybrid integration skills: site-to-cloud connectivity, private networking, DNS, certificates, edge/IoT.
  • IaC & DevOps: Terraform (or Bicep/ARM), Git-based workflows, pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), artifact registries.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes/AKS (or similar), registry, ingress, telemetry, backup/DR patterns.
  • Awareness of data flows from OT systems (OPC UA, MQTT, or equivalent).
  • Security-by-design approach (identity, secrets management, policy-as-code, vulnerability management, compliance).
  • Effective collaborator communication with multi‑functional and international teams.
  • Degree in Engineering (any), Computer Science, or proven equivalent experience.
  • Proficient English, knowledge of other languages is an asset.
  • Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, AWS) are a plus.
  • Familiarity with edge runtimes (Azure IoT Edge, Kubernetes at the edge), time‑series/observability stacks.
About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Growing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H₂ and derivative fuels will rise. Our focus is on decarbonizing manufacturing and adopting balanced approaches with industry clients, global networks, tech, and coordinated implementation.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than ~100,000 dedicated employees, we generate electricity for over 16% of the global community and use our technology to protect people and the environment. Our cross‑border team is committed to redefining the energy sector by exploring new possibilities to achieve balanced, reliable, and affordable energy solutions. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Our Office

Siemens Energy's location in One Cotroceni Park is not just an office space – it's a hub for a vibrant and growing community! Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the flawless place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. The Academia Militara subway station is just a 3‑minute walk away, making city travel easy.

description:
Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Role Summary

The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects. The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value‑based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well‑positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities Product & Solution Representation
  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.
Business Development
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.
  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry‑docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.
Sales Strategy & Reporting
  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.
Skills and Competencies
  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long‑term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value‑driven commercial solutions.
Experience Requirements
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers.
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.
Other Information

title: Global Head of Cloud Alliances
description:

Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What we are looking for in you:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: DESENVOLVEDOR DE INTEGRAÇÃO
description:
Estamos em busca de umDesenvolvedor de Integração que irá a tuar como responsável técnico pela camada de integração entre os sistemas SAP (ERP S/4HANA e IS-U HANA) e os sistemas legados da Light, aplicando práticas de DevSecOps para garantir entregas seguras, escaláveis, automatizadas e de alta disponibilidade. O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para aLight !

Seus desafios serão:

  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.
  • Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório.
  • Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.
  • Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.
  • Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
  • Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevSecOps aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas.
  • Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e WebServices.
  • Experiência com integração segura (HTTPS, JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls).
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Automação de testes e validações em integrações.
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise).
  • Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.).
  • Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

Nosso propósito é transformar a sociedade por meio da nossa energia, levando desenvolvimento e bem-estar por onde passamos todos os dias. E fazer parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros, por mais de um século, só reforça a nossa contribuição com o crescimento econômico e social do país.

Somos uma das maiores empresas privadas do setor elétrico brasileiro que atua, por meio de uma cadeia de valor integrada nos processos de geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia para 31 municípios do Rio de Janeiro, além da comercialização de energia para todo o Brasil.

Aqui, os desafios são diários e queremos que os nossos mais de 4 milhões de clientes tenham sempre a melhor experiência de atendimento, com serviços de alta qualidade.

Temos um time diverso de colaboradores campeões, que seguem juntos, colocando em prática o nosso propósito. Gente que sonha grande, quebra barreiras e faz história. Afinal, cuidar da energia que transforma a vida de tanta gente faz parte do nosso DNA!

Um Gerente de Loja apaixonado por varejo, beleza limpa e experiência do cliente . Você será responsável por liderar a operação da loja, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, organizado e inspirador para os clientes e sua equipe. Seu papel é transformar cada visita à loja em uma jornada sensorial e emocional, promovendo um atendimento consultivo e autêntico.

  • Garantir a organização da loja, em geral.
  • Gerenciar com a equipe a reposição de produtos no salão de vendas;
  • Cuidar da decoração/disposição de produtos e realizar as trocas da vitrine;
  • Controlar e manter estoque: pedidos de produtos ao CD, conferência, estocagem de produtos, entrada de notas fiscais no sistema e emissão de notas fiscais referentes as saídas de produtos destinados (brindes, perdas, uso e consumo, testes, dentre outros);

  • Prestar atendimento na venda de kits para empresas/clientes e organização da entrega;
  • Manutenção geral da loja, incluindo solicitação de pintura, reparos, troca de lâmpadas, manutenção de ar condicionado, etc.;
  • Garantir a conciliação do caixa/movimento da loja por tipo de recebimento (cheques, dinheiro, cartão de crédito);
  • Realizar depósitos diários do caixa na conta da empresa;
  • Gerenciar o trabalho da equipe, garantindo cumprimento das obrigações trabalhistas;
  • Ministrar treinamentos teóricos e práticos;
  • Realizar processos de seleção de equipe, com apoio do RH.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Cosmetologia, Estética ou áreas afins;
  • Atuação como Gerente em redes varejistas;
  • Experiência anterior com cosméticos será considerada diferencial;
  • Ambiente integrado, alegre e positivo , onde a colaboração faz parte da rotina.
  • Vale-Refeição para curtir bons momentos e conversas descontraídas enquanto saboreia suas refeições.
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida , porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Afinal, mente sã em corpo são é o que importa!
  • Total Pass , para manter o corpo em movimento e a energia sempre lá em cima.
  • Descontos exclusivos nos produtos que você já ama: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty.
  • Ambiente que estimula a criatividade e o aprendizado contínuo , com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do nosso Programa de Educação Continuada — incluindo subsídios para cursos de aperfeiçoamento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
  • Parcerias com instituições de ensino e idiomas , como Estácio e Open English, para facilitar ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados , valorizando quem cresce e constrói junto com a gente.
É muita história para contar...

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

Job Description

Fugro’s innovation teams are responsible for carrying out developments serving both internal users and Fugro clients. How We Work

At Fugro, we believe in alignment, autonomy, and personal accountability throughout the product life cycle. Our collaborative work environment blends the flexibility of remote work with in‑office collaboration, fostering a culture built on trust.

About Fugro

Fugro is the world’s leading independent provider of geo‑intelligence and asset integrity solutions for large construction, infrastructure, and natural resources. We collect and analyze data about the Earth and the structures built upon it, providing comprehensive information and advice to our clients to help them make better decisions about their assets and projects. We rely on innovation to push the transition towards net‑zero carbon, safe infrastructure and climate resilience to deliver on our promise to create a safe and livable world.

Why would you join us?

International Geo‑data environment – We work for and with the entire world. The Earth is fascinating, as are the people on it. We work hard to create and maintain an inclusive culture. Challenging projects and exciting opportunities – We are ahead of the curve and have the best projects to work on. In addition, exciting opportunities arise around the world every day. Freedom to grow faster – If you are prepared to take the initiative, ample opportunities locally or worldwide await you at Fugro.

title: Principal Platform Engineer, Americas
description:
We’re looking for a curious, rigorous, problem-hungry platform engineer (who codes!) to carry the ball as we bring Ashby to the big leagues. Ashby builds software that lets talent teams build an efficient, delightful, respectful hiring process. Similarly, you’re an engineer who wants to build a “paved road” that excellent engineering teams can safely take to the moon and back.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 2500 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we’re hiring for this role.

We’ve listed this role twice: as a Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer – our team does both, and we are open to candidates who lean towards one or the other.

About the role and how we work

Hi I’m Colin, Head of EMEA Engineering. I’ve spent a number of years leading engineering teams in startups, and that has always included being close to infrastructure teams - no matter what name they’ve worn (SRE, infrastructure, platform, etc). I’ve got my hands dirty building the initial infrastructure for startups and know the value a talented infrastructure engineer brings. The rigour, the discipline, the peace and quiet when everything just hums along.

Our infrastructure is in a good place for now. Nothing is static. Ashby continues to grow rapidly, putting strain on our existing infrastructure. We’re always looking to give our customers more powerful hiring software, and building new product features often requires new pieces of infrastructure.

Having herded plenty of snowflake servers in the past, I’ve learned there’s a better way. I (and Ashby) place a lot of value on code-as-infrastructure. As a Platform Engineer at Ashby, you’ll get to dive into scaling problems, add new capabilities to our platform, and think about how our entire team interacts with infrastructure. All our own engineers own their projects end-to-end and ship with minimal oversight. We don’t put roadblocks to ensure security when common sense will do and we don’t build processes like change management boards around the lowest common denominator. But with great power comes great responsibility: we handle personal and confidential data about some of the biggest decisions we ever make at work. As we grow, more and bigger customers rely on us to be reliable and secure and how we operate internally will need to evolve.

We’re at an inflection point where our ability to scale and deliver a seamless experience has a make-or-break impact – we have some of the fastest growing companies using our platform every day to hire hundreds of people per month. We need someone like you to make good decisions, debug thorny issues, and build us a future-proof platform that can withstand this scale. Our small but mighty infrastructure team has set up a secure and simple environment (we don’t believe in spinning up a new service unless necessary!) for our growing product team to build in. That’s where you come in: you, too, will own projects end-to-end and have an impact on core parts of the Ashby developer and user experience. For instance, you could work on:

  • Optimize our homegrown ultra-dynamic recruiting DSL-to-SQL compiler, and create tools to help developers do so
  • Create automated guardrails for the security and privacy of our customer data
  • Help our developers ship features fast through canary deploys, gradual rollouts and feature flags, while keeping complexity manageable and reducing downtime
  • Work with the business and the engineering team to define SLOs and implement the corresponding SLIs.
  • Ensure all communication with external services supports circuit-breakers.
  • Implement the infrastructure to support an event-driven architecture and data warehouse.
Why you should or shouldn’t apply

You should apply if:

  • You never stop. You get weirdly obsessed about a problem that doesn’t yet make sense, turn it every which way in your head until the explanation dawns. You’ll search every rock, inventory every clue, hunt every mismatch. We do that, too – together we’ll be armed with state‑of‑the‑art monitoring tools and an impressive amount of data, and join you in the adventure.
  • You don’t take shortcuts. You’re speaking up for the future user, the edge case, the doomsday design. You know product engineers want to build it with you, and see them as allies, where you give them the power and knowledge to access greater things.
  • You’re someone who cares about what you do and the team you do it with, and want to work with others who do as well. You’ll be on interview panels choosing your next colleagues, and you’ll take that seriously. You only want to work with people who make you better, and want to make you better.
  • You’ve built infrastructure at a slightly later stage than Ashby is at - you know how to deal with millions of data points, have seen great (or not great) infrastructure make or break customer experience, and have automated everything from provisioning to monitoring and release process.
  • You’re a Swiss army knife (all nationalities welcome). You’ll get every hard problem the company faces. You’ll get to do infrastructure updates, security enforcements, database optimization, Kubernetes debugging, and digging through Typescript traces figuring out what doesn’t work. You probably don’t feel like an expert at at least some of that… and that appeals to you.

You should not apply if:

  • You don’t want to make your own decisions on what is the best paved road to build for Ashby, and expect a lead or manager to make the final call on what that is. Our leads (and managers) give ample commentary and feedback on technical decisions and how they’re made, but you ship what you want to build and are accountable for it.
  • You hate SQL. We have a lot of features built around making the best out of data, and our platform engineers also sometimes dive into a gnarly report or advise engineers on a more performant data model to use.
  • You don’t want to code. Our SREs are some of our best software engineers and they are just as responsible for the application as the other engineering teams – albeit at a platform level. Reviewing code and submitting code changes will be part of your day to day.
  • Your primary mode of communicating best practices to engineers is live meetings. We’re a very async culture and written communication (and code) is how changes get made. As an Ashby SRE, you will need to share new tooling and best practices with engineers faster than your next meeting opportunity will take you.
  • You’ve never delivered a project, on your own, without someone prodding you for updates. We have no project or delivery managers to fill your calendar with busy work, but the flip side is you have to do your project management, seek the help you need to get unstuck and cut scope when it’s worthwhile.
Technology Stack

We use TypeScript (frontend & backend), Node.js, React, Apollo GraphQL, Postgres, Redis. We use Datadog and Sentry on 100% cloud‑based (AWS) infra. We take developer experience and reliability seriously: all engineers are on call in a follow‑the‑sun model, and everyone contributes to developer tooling.

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top‑tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high‑quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Ad Demand Partnerships Manager (Remote)
description:
MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, helping publishers maximize revenue by building strong, transparent, and diversified demand partnerships. We work with leading DSPs, SSPs, ad networks, and agencies worldwide to create a more competitive auction environment that drives higher fill rates and stronger returns for publishers across web, app, and CTV. This role is central to that mission: scaling and optimizing our global demand stack, forging strategic relationships with top programmatic buyers, and ensuring sustainable, diversified revenue growth.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Manager of Ad Demand Partnerships to dramatically expand and nurture and optimize our programmatic demand partnerships stack. This is a critical, revenue-generating role focused on forging new strategic relationships with global and niche Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs), Supply Side Platforms (SSPs), Ad Networks, and other premium demand partner sources.

Your success will be measured by your ability to increase competition within our ad stack, resulting in higher fill rates and Session RPMs/CPMs for our publishers' inventory across all platforms (web, app, and CTV).

Key Responsibilities Demand Acquisition & Financial Strategy
  • New Partner Sourcing: Proactively identify, prioritize, negotiate, and close new demand partnership agreements with top-tier global and regional advertising platforms (DSPs, Ad Networks, Media Agencies, Trading Desks).
  • Contract Negotiation: Strategically negotiate solid revenue share models and favorable payment terms with demand partners, ad networks that mutually benefit both MonetizeMore and our Publishers.
  • Key Account Focus: Establish and maintain high-level relationships with major programmatic buyers, including companies like The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Amazon, Criteo, and similar companies.
  • Revenue Diversification: Optimize the auction bid pressure from non-Google demand partners to diversify revenue sources for MonetizeMore publishers. Increase the Share of Voice (SOV) from revenue originating from Non-Google Demand to improve our overall revenue diversification.
  • Inventory Expansion: Seek opportunities to add value to our publishers' inventory by targeting local ad agencies that may be interested in buying direct inventory or PMP deals.
  • Media Kit Development: Create a professional solid media kit and compelling pitch materials that will entice demand partners, ad networks, and agencies to buy our inventory.
Technical Integration & Operational Oversight
  • Header Bidding Expertise: Initiate and lead the technical and business integration of new demand partners via MonetizeMore’s proprietary Header Bidding wrapper, ensuring seamless and low-latency performance.
  • Platform Diversification: Drive monetization growth across emerging channels, including Connected TV (CTV), Mobile App Monetization, and other high-growth video environments.
  • Financial Flow Ownership: Take ownership of the payment pipeline and work closely with the Finance Team to ensure demand partner payments are received on time and continue to avoid issues paying our publisher payments are always received on time.
  • Integration Process Management: Work closely with our Ad Ops and Engineering teams to manage the technical onboarding lifecycle process, including seamless communication between ad ops and demand partner setup on new publishers, from initial testing to full launch and optimization.
Communication & Reporting
  • High-Impact Communication: Clearly and effectively communicate complex technical and business terms to both internal teams and external executive partners.
  • Documentation & Training: Break down complex demand integration processes into simple, clear chunks for internal training and documentation.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends (privacy changes, identity solutions, supply path optimization, etc.) and translate their impact into actionable demand strategies.
Required Qualifications
  • Experience: 3+ years of successful experience in a Demand Partnerships, Business Development, or Supply/Monetization role within the Ad Tech or Publisher space.
  • Industry Knowledge: Solid, expert-level understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including Header Bidding (Prebid), SSPs, DSPs, and Ad Exchanges.
  • Strategic Negotiator: Proven ability to negotiate and manage commercial contracts, specifically focusing on revenue share and net payment terms.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of ad demand integration processes, including VAST/VPAID for video, SDKs for app monetization, and general ad serving logic.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to solve problems, initiate partnerships via cold outreach, negotiate and present to senior leaders and executive-level contacts.
  • Organization: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adept at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.
Bonus Qualifications (A Major Plus)
  • Deep DSP Network: Existing contacts and relationships with key decision-makers at The Trade Desk or other major DSPs and SSPs/Trading Desks.
  • Trade Desk Experience: Previous employment experience at The Trade Desk or a similar Tier-1 DSP.
  • Global Focus: Experience managing demand partners and monetization across diverse international markets (EMEA, APAC, LATAM).

description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the role

Being a Model Auditor at Nubank is different from being a traditional auditor. In a digital bank driven by data, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence, our audit function also embraces technology to assess risks predictively and continuously.

This position is fundamental to Nu's success. You will be part of the Internal Audit team, focusing on Financial Risks (Credit, Market, Liquidity, and Capital). Your primary goal will be to provide assurance on Nubank's financial models.

You'll be responsible for

Your main challenge will be to translate statistical and data concepts into auditable financial risks. Your activities will include:

  • Evaluating and critiquing risk models (including statistical and Machine Learning models), from their conception, development, and validation to their ongoing monitoring.
  • Applying your knowledge of mathematics and statistics to analyze the robustness, performance, and adherence of these models.
  • Executing audit tests using data analysis, you will be expected to explore large volumes of data to identify risks, biases, or control failures.
  • Leading technical discussions with stakeholders (such as Data Scientists, Engineers, and the Risk team) and communicating audit findings clearly, objectively, and constructively (both verbally and in writing).
  • Preparing audit reports and following up on the implementation of action plans to remediate identified vulnerabilities.
We are looking for a person who has
  • Strong knowledge in mathematics and statistics, and experience applying these concepts to analyze or build models (whether in data science, credit, finance, or related fields).
  • Practical experience with data analysis. While you don't need to master a specific language (like Python or SQL), you must have experience in extracting, manipulating, and analyzing data to generate insights.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. You know how to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms to various audiences.
  • An analytical and problem-solving profile, with strong critical thinking skills to break down complex problems and propose solutions.
  • Is organized and detail-oriented, without losing sight of the big picture.
  • Previous experience or knowledge in Internal Audit, Internal Controls, or Risk Management (especially Credit Risk or Market Risk) is a plus
  • Knowledge of the financial market, credit products, or fintechs is a plus

title: SAP Cutover Lead
description:
Senior SAP Cutover Lead

Location: Remote – Brazil

Experience: 10+ Years


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP Cutover Lead to plan, manage, and execute cutover activities across complex SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA, RISE, and cloud-based migrations . The ideal candidate will be responsible for orchestrating all phases of the technical and business cutover, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring a smooth transition from legacy to target systems with minimal disruption to operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the end-to-end cutover strategy , timeline, and execution plan for SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • Coordinate with functional, technical, BASIS, infrastructure, and business process teams to define cutover tasks, dependencies, and sequencing.
  • Drive the development of cutover checklists, runbooks, and readiness assessments .
  • Conduct mock cutovers and rehearsals to validate timing, resources, and risk mitigation.
  • Monitor and report progress during each phase of the cutover cycle; manage go/no-go checkpoints.
  • Identify and proactively resolve cutover issues and risks to maintain go-live stability.
  • Collaborate with project management, business owners, and system integrators to ensure alignment with overall deployment milestones.
  • Facilitate post-cutover reviews, stabilization planning, and transition to support teams.
  • Maintain detailed documentation and ensure compliance with change control and audit standards.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of SAP experience, with 5+ years leading cutover planning and execution for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or RISE programs.
  • Proven track record managing large-scale, multi-stream cutovers involving multiple systems and geographies.
  • Strong understanding of SAP technical architecture, BASIS operations, and infrastructure dependencies.
  • Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills—capable of working with distributed global teams.
  • Hands-on experience with cutover management tools (e.g., SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager, MS Project, Jira, or Smartsheet).
  • Ability to anticipate risks and design effective fallback and recovery plans.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills with a proactive, detail-oriented approach.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP RISE migrations, Greenfield/Brownfield implementations , and system consolidations .
  • Familiarity with cloud hosting (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and hybrid landscape cutovers.
  • Certification in SAP Activate or PMP/Prince2 project management.


Why Join Us

  • Lead mission-critical cutovers across global SAP programs.
  • Collaborate with seasoned SAP professionals across functional and technical domains.
  • Remote flexibility with opportunities for long-term global project exposure.

description:
Descrição da Empresa: Pronto para trabalhar na empresa que é referência em soluções contábeis especializadas para o setor automotivo?


Atuamos com excelência técnica, transparência e inovação tecnológica, garantindo aos nossos clientes um serviço contábil completo e seguro.


Nosso propósito é simplificar a contabilidade e potencializar o crescimento sustentável das empresas.

Objetivo do Cargo

Executar, revisar e analisar processos contábeis e fiscais de empresas enquadradas nos regimes Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional, garantindo a conformidade das demonstrações contábeis, o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a aderência às normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes..


Principais Responsabilidades
  • Realizar e revisar lançamentos contábeis, conciliações bancárias, de contas patrimoniais e de resultado.
  • Efetuar o fechamento contábil mensal.
  • Elaborar balancetes, demonstrações.
  • Garantir a correta classificação e contabilização de receitas, despesas, custos e provisões.
  • Apoiar na elaboração e revisão das ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital) e ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal).
  • Identificar inconsistências e propor ajustes contábeis e fiscais.
  • revisão e conciliação dos tributos apurados (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS).
  • Efetuar a conferência das obrigações acessórias fiscais com as contábeis.
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária e contábil.


Informações da vaga
  • Regime de contratação:  CLT (efetivo)
  • Horário:  Segunda a quinta das 8h às 18h, sexta das 8h às 17h (1h de almoço)
  • Modelo de trabalho:  100% presencial
  • Local:  Rod. Washington Luiz, 2550, Parque Duque, Duque de Caxias – RJ (CEP )


Perfil ideal

Profissional detalhista, proativo(a), comprometido(a) com prazos e qualidade técnica, com facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e disposição para contribuir com a melhoria contínua dos processos contábeis.


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)

Essenciais para garantir precisão, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade nas entregas contábeis:

  • Fechamento contábil completo  (mensal e anual);
  • Domínio das obrigações acessórias  — ECD, ECF, DCTF e SPED Contábil;
  • Conciliação contábil e análise de contas patrimoniais e de resultado ;
  • Apuração de impostos e classificação contábil correta ;
  • Conhecimento sólido das normas contábeis (CPCs e NBCs) ;
  • Domínio em Excel (intermediário a avançado)  — fórmulas, planilhas dinâmicas e relatórios;
  • Experiência com sistemas contábeis integrados  (como Questor, Domínio, Alterdata, Prosoft ou similares);
  • Elaboração e interpretação de balanços e demonstrações financeiras ;
  • Análise e conferência de documentos fiscais ;
  • Atualização constante em legislação fiscal e tributária.

title: Registration Assistant
description:
Mission of the Role:

Due to growth & expansion of business in Brazil, CAC is looking to hire a seasoned professional who will be responsible for support and accelerate product registration and compliance activities in the Brazilian market , reporting to Registration manager in Brazil. The key objectives for this role are:

  • Managing the submission, follow-up, and maintenance of product registrations in Brazil
  • ensures compliance with national regulatory requirements (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) and supports the company’s product launch plans in alignment with global and regional regulatory strategies.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and execute registration strategies for Brazil in line with business priorities and product portfolio
  • Prepare, compile, and submit registration dossiers for technical and formulated products in compliance with local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external consultants, laboratories, manufacturers, and internal technical teams to ensure high-quality and complete submissions.
  • Communicate with regulatory authorities (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) through local partners or directly when required.
  • Monitor progress of submissions, follow up on authority requests, and manage timelines to ensure efficient approval.
  • Track and analyze updates in Brazilian and LATAM regulatory frameworks, assessing potential business impacts and advising management accordingly.
  • Maintain accurate registration data and documentation archives to ensure full traceability and compliance.
  • Provide regulatory support to commercial, marketing, and R&D teams regarding registration timelines, status, and compliance requirements.
  • Support post-registration activities, such as renewals, label updates, and re-registration processes.
  • Collaborate with global regulatory teams to align strategies and share best practices.



Technical Knowledge and Skills:

  • Graduate in Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Toxicology, Environmental Science, or related fields.
  • 4 years of working experience in regulatory affairs or product registration within the agrochemical / crop protection industry.
  • In-depth understanding of Brazil’s registration procedures and authorities: MAPA/IBMA/ANVISA and state authorities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple registration projects with strict timelines
  • Strong coordination and communication skills with internal cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in English (written & spoken) and Portuguese (mandatory for Brazil-based communication).
  • Detail-oriented and capable of interpreting technical and scientific data.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Previous experience in a multinational agrochemical company or regulatory consulting firm


Soft skill:

  • Demonstrates a proactive, self-driven approach with a high sense of accountability.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment
